statements.impact_statement: Plugin privilege validation in the Docker daemon. The agent only uses the Docker API client (github.com/docker/docker/client); govulncheck reaches the module only through package initialisation. The fix exists only in the still-beta github.com/moby/moby/v2; migrate when it is stable (docs/SECURITY-SCANNING.md).

AuthZ plugin bypass in the Docker daemon's request handling. The agent only uses the Docker API client; govulncheck reaches the module only through package initialisation. The fix exists only in the still-beta github.com/moby/moby/v2; migrate when it is stable (docs/SECURITY-SCANNING.md).

golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is not linked: frp does not import it. The embedded frpc is built stripped (like the upstream release), so govulncheck's binary mode cannot see which packages are linked and reports the whole module; an unstripped build from the same frp/ module shows the package as not reachable. Our own code: not reachable.
